name: tuneitverse
description: TuneItVerse - industry-leading open ECU tuning platform. Full offline BIN/XDF/A2L tools, expanded ECU DB with per-family capabilities, experimental P01 write (off by default), EDC16 report-only checksum, improved seed/key, plugin foundations. Not all hardware paths bench-tested.

scripts.build:innosetup: tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && iscc installer\TuneItVerse.iss && node scripts/copy-installer.js
